# Regexp

> Small bounded regular-expression engine for Ada and SPARK-compatible code.

Regexp provides a compact API for compiling regular-expression patterns and
matching them against Ada `String` values with bounded pattern size, bounded
compiled state count, and configurable match step limits.

Toolchain policy: use Alire GNAT 15 only. The root, tests, and `check_regexp`
crates pin `gnat_native = "=15.2.1"`. Validate with
`alr exec -- gnatls --version`; do not run plain system `gnat*`, `gnatmake`,
`gnatls`, `gnatprove`, or `gprbuild` in this workspace.

## Use This Library When

- You need regular-expression search in Ada.
- You want predictable compile and match limits.
- You need simple editor/project-search style regex features.
- You want a small API that is easy to call from SPARK-compatible code.

## Do Not Assume

- This is not a full PCRE-compatible engine.
- Empty alternatives and empty groups are supported.
- Match offsets are not absolute source indexes; they are one-based offsets
  relative to the `Text` argument passed to the match function.
- The default match is ASCII case-insensitive.

## Core API

```ada
Compiled : constant Regexp.Compile_Result := Regexp.Compile ("a.c");
Found    : Regexp.Match_Result;

if Compiled.Status = Regexp.Compile_Ok then
   Found := Regexp.Find_First (Compiled.Expression, "xxabcxx");
end if;
```

Main functions:

- `Compile (Pattern, Max_Pattern_Length, Max_States) return Compile_Result`
- `Compile_Literal (Pattern, Max_Pattern_Length, Max_States) return Compile_Result`
- `Compile_Literal_Set (Text, Literals, Max_Pattern_Length, Max_States) return Compile_Result`
- `Compile_Literal_Word_Set (Text, Literals, Max_Pattern_Length, Max_States) return Compile_Result`
- `Compile_Anchored`, `Compile_Whole_Word`, `Compile_Line`
- `Compile_Literal_Anchored`, `Compile_Literal_Whole_Word`, `Compile_Literal_Line`
- `Default_Options`, `Case_Sensitive_Options`, `Multiline_Options`, `Dot_All_Options`, `UTF_8_Options`
- `Character_Mode_Type`, `ASCII_Mode`, `UTF_8_Mode`, `Validate_UTF_8`, `UTF_8_Validation_Result`
- `Supports_Syntax`, `Syntax_Feature_Image`, `Supported_Syntax`, `Supported_Syntax_Detail`
- `Digit_Class`, `Word_Class`, `Whitespace_Class`, `Identifier_Start_Class`
- `Escape_Literal (Pattern) return String`
- `Escape_Replacement (Replacement) return String`
- `Append_Fragment`, `Append_Literal`, `Append_Literal_Alternative`
- `Append_Class_Literal`, `Append_Class_Range`
- `Build_Character_Class`, `Build_Literal_Alternation`, `Build_Literal_Word_Alternation`
- `Is_Valid (Expression) return Boolean`
- `Is_Literal`, `Is_Anchored`, `Is_Whole_Line`, `Needs_Backtracking`, `Can_Stream_Safely`
- `Recommended_Strategy`
- `Summary`, `Fingerprint`, `Pattern_Fingerprint`, `Metadata`, `Pattern_Metadata`
- `Source_Kind`, `Copy_Source_Pattern`, `Lint`
- `Compile_Diagnostic`, `Replacement_Diagnostic`

- `Count_Matches (Expression, Text, Count, Status, Options)`
- `Find_First (Expression, Text, Options) return Match_Result`

- `Find_From_Planned (Expression, Text, From, Options) return Match_Result`
- `Find_From_Planned_With_Captures`
- `Capture_Count (Expression) return Natural`
- `Capture_Index (Expression, Name) return Natural`
- `Named_Captures`
- `Capture_Name (Expression, Index, Output, Last, Status)`
- `Has_Captures`, `Uses_Anchors`, `May_Match_Empty`, `Required_Prefix`, `Features`, `Validate_Policy`
- `Validate_Policy_Detail`, `Pattern_Policy_Diagnostic`, `Policy_Feature`
- `Literal_Search_Policy`, `Editor_Search_Policy`, `No_Backtracking_Features_Policy`
- `Safe_User_Search_Policy`, `Streaming_Search_Policy`, `Editor_Replace_Policy`

- `Named_Capture_Range`
- `Find_First_With_Captures` / `Find_From_With_Captures`
- `Find_All (Expression, Text, Matches, Count, Status, Options)`
- `Find_All_From (Expression, Text, From, Matches, Count, Status, Options)`
- `Find_First_Of`, `Find_From_Of`, `Tokenize`
- `Tokenize_With_Kinds`, `Find_First_Of_With_Captures`, `Find_From_Of_With_Captures`, `Tokenize_With_Captures`
- `Find_All_With_Captures` / `Find_All_With_Captures_From`
- `Find_All_Overlapping_With_Captures` / `Find_All_Overlapping_With_Captures_From`
- `Find_All_Lines`, `Find_All_Summary`, `Find_All_Line_Summary`
- `Find_All_Overlapping` / `Find_All_Overlapping_From`
- `Start` / `Next` / `Next_With_Captures` / `Next_Captured` / `Next_Line_Captured` with `Match_Cursor`
- `Start_Token_Stream` / `Feed_Tokens` / `Feed_Tokens_Detail` /
  `Feed_Tokens_With_Captures` with `Token_Stream_Cursor` and `Token_Stream_Status`
- `Start_Stream` / `Feed` / `Feed_With_Captures` with `Stream_Cursor`
- `Replace_First` / `Replace_All`
- `Replace_First_Count` / `Replace_All_Count`
- `Replace_First_Size` / `Replace_All_Size`
- `Required_First_Output_Length`, `Required_All_Output_Length`, `Replacement_Fits`
- `Plan_Replacement`, `Plan_Replacement_Detail`, `Replacement_Output_Map`, `Replacement_Plan`
- `Validate_Replacement` / `Validate_Replacement_Detail` / `Replacement_References`
- `Replacement_Summary`
- `Replace_First_Preserving_Case` / `Replace_All_Preserving_Case`
- `Split`
- `Replace_All_Lines`, `Split_Lines`
- `Copy_Match`
- `Debug_Dump` / `Explain` / `Explain_Nodes`
- `Format_Compile_Diagnostic` / `Format_Replacement_Diagnostic`
- `Benchmark_Pattern`, `Benchmark_Text`
- `Benchmark_Summary`, `Make_Token_Name`, `Copy_Token_Name`
- `Matches_Entire (Expression, Text, Options) return Match_Result`
- `Is_Syntax_Error`, `Is_Unsupported`, `Is_Limit_Error`
- `Status_Image (Status) return String`

`Stream_Cursor` retains `Default_Stream_Buffer_Length` bytes so matches can
span chunk boundaries. Stream match offsets are one-based from the start of the
stream. After `Stream_Match`, call `Feed` again with an empty chunk to drain
additional buffered matches.
Use the `Start_Stream` overload with `Max_Buffer_Length` for a smaller
per-cursor retained-buffer limit.

Replacement strings expand `\0`, `\1` through `\9`, `\k<name>`, and `\\`.
They support case escapes `\U...\E`, `\L...\E`, `\u`, and `\l`.
- `Diagnostic_Image (Result) return String`

## Supported Pattern Syntax

- Literals
- `.`
- `^` and `$`
- Character classes: `[abc]`, `[^abc]`, `[a-z]`
- Character-class operators: `[a-z&&[^aeiou]]`, `[a-z--[aeiou]]`
- Quantifiers: `*`, `+`, `?`
- Bounded repeats: `{m}`, `{m,n}`, `{m,}`
- Lazy quantifiers: `*?`, `+?`, `??`, `{m,n}?`
- Possessive quantifiers: `*+`, `++`, `?+`, `{m,n}+`
- Numbered capture grouping: `(cat|dog)`
- Named capture grouping: `(?<name>cat|dog)`
- Non-capturing grouping: `(?:cat|dog)`, `(?:ab)+`
- Atomic grouping: `(?>cat|dog)`
- Lookahead assertions: `(?=cat)`, `(?!cat)`
- Fixed-width lookbehind assertions: `(?<=cat)`, `(?<!cat)`
- Scoped inline options: `(?i:cat)`, `(?-i:cat)`, `(?m:^cat)`, `(?s:.)`
- Top-level alternation: `cat|dog`
- Backreferences to earlier captures: `\1`, `\k<name>`
- Escapes: `\d`, `\D`, `\w`, `\W`, `\s`, `\S`
- Word boundaries: `\b`, `\B`
- Unicode property classes: `\p{...}`, `\P{...}`
- Escaped metacharacters: `\.`, `\*`, `\+`, `\?`, `\[`, `\]`, `\\`, `\^`, `\$`, `\|`

Captures inside lookahead and lookbehind assertions are assertion-local and are
not exported by `Capture_Count` or capture-aware match results. Generate only
fixed-width lookbehind patterns; variable-width lookbehind is rejected as
`Unsupported_Syntax`.
Inline option groups are scoped to the group body. Use `i`/`-i` for
case-insensitive or case-sensitive matching, `m`/`-m` for multiline anchors,
and `s`/`-s` for dot-newline behavior.
Backreferences must refer to captures declared earlier in the pattern.
Possessive quantifiers and atomic groups commit to their longest internal match.
Atomic subpatterns currently reject captures and backreferences.

Unsupported syntax returns `Unsupported_Syntax`.

## Build Commands

```sh
alr exec -- gprbuild -P regexp.gpr
alr exec -- gprbuild -P examples/examples.gpr
```

Run examples:

```sh
examples/bin/basic_search
examples/bin/compile_errors
```

Full release validation:

```sh
alr build
alr exec -- gprbuild -P regexp.gpr
cd tests && alr exec -- gprbuild -P tests.gpr
cd tests && ./bin/tests
alr exec -- gprbuild -P examples/examples.gpr
alr exec -- gprbuild -P tools/tools.gpr
tools/bin/check_all
```

`tools/bin/check_all` requires Alire GNAT 15, runs GNATprove through `alr exec`,
runs `check_regexp`, validates the
staged `check_regexp/alire.release.toml` workflow, and requires a clean Git
worktree after intended changes are committed.
